parts.stem: Put the steps of urine formation and excretion in the correct order.

items.value: Urine is released to the outside.
Urine is stored temporarily in the bladder.
Blood containing harmful nitrogenous wastes is carried to the kidneys.
Excretory materials are transferred from the kidneys to the bladder.
Wastes are filtered from the blood.

correct_answer: Blood containing harmful nitrogenous wastes is carried to the kidneys.
Wastes are filtered from the blood.
Excretory materials are transferred from the kidneys to the bladder.
Urine is stored temporarily in the bladder.
Urine is released to the outside.
